claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Pindolol is a non-cytotoxic beta-adrenoceptor/5-HT1A antagonist that is not expected to kill cancer cells at 2.5 uM; any weak antiproliferative effect would reflect adrenergic/serotonergic receptor antagonism rather than a cytotoxic mechanism.
